intro: Slovakia is a mountainous, landlocked country in the Carpathians, with the dramatic High Tatras and some of Europe's most spectacular caves.

chapters.title: Tatras and the Danube
text: The High Tatras, the highest part of the Carpathians, hold Slovakia's highest peak, Gerlachovský štít. In the south-west the Danube flows past Bratislava, the only capital that borders two other countries, Austria and Hungary. Bratislava and Vienna are only about 55 km apart.
Slovakia borders Czechia, Poland, Ukraine, Hungary and Austria.

chapters.title: Caves and castles
text: Slovakia has thousands of caves, including ice caves and the Ochtinská aragonite cave, one of only a few like it in the world. Its countryside is scattered with castle ruins, such as the huge Spiš Castle.

keyTerms.meaning: A mineral that can form delicate, branching crystals in caves.
